Exercise: Spell Caster

Category:
strength

Exercise Type:
compound

Force Type:
pull

Difficulty Level:
beginner

Movement Patterns:

- rotational

Primary Muscles:

- abdominals

Secondary Muscles:

- glutes
- shoulders

Equipment:

- dumbbell

Fatigue Score:
2

Systemic Fatigue:
low

Stimulus To Fatigue Ratio:
3

Energy Requirement:
moderate

Recovery Time:
1 hours

Goals:

- rotational_strength
- core_stability

Contraindications:
None

Exercise Variations:

- variation_name: Single-Arm Dumbbell Rotation, equipment: dumbbell

Substitution Options:

- exercise_name: Renegade Row, equipment: dumbbell

Instructions:

- Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a pronated grip. Your feet should be wide with your hips and knees extended. This will be your starting position.
- Begin the movement by pulling both of the dumbbells to one side next to your hip, rotating your torso.
- Keeping your arms straight and the dumbbells parallel to the ground, rotate your torso to swing the weights to your opposite side.
- Continue alternating, rotating from one side to the other until the set is complete.
